summary: DocuAnalytics preview-only testing of (1) assistant sign-up tracking, (2) admin privacy deletion tool (dry-run / simulation / audit), (3) admin assistant KPIs. Backend extra verified: POST /api/assistant/signup with Bearer token of an OLD account (mario@studio.it, created 2026-07-29 — >48h ago) returns {counted:false, reason:'existing_account'} as required. Frontend E2E on https://pre-launch-verify-2.preview.emergentagent.com: (a) /assistant?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social → profile select → 1 chat message → CTA bar visible → click assistant-cta-register sets localStorage da_from_assistant with sid+utm → navigates to /?auth=register&src=assistant&utm_source=linkedin → AuthModal opens → registered test_a*@example.com with name/email/password → modal closed, da_token set, 3 Crediti visible in header, welcome toast shown. GET /api/assistant/stats delta: signup_completed total +1 and utm_source=linkedin +1 (perfect attribution). localStorage da_from_assistant cleared after successful signup. (b) Normal register (direct /?auth=register with cleared localStorage) → no signup_completed increment (delta 0). (c) Visit /assistant WITHOUT clicking CTA then login mario@studio.it via Accedi button → no signup_completed increment (delta 0), 'Accesso effettuato' toast, 6 Crediti. (d) /admin/assistant: KPI 'Registrazioni completate'=2 visible; tables 'Per canale' and 'Per giorno' both include 'REGISTRAZIONI COMPLETATE' column; linkedin row shows 1/1 100% conversion. (e) /admin/privacy: wrong token → 'Token admin non valido'; correct token → page admin-privacy-page with badge 'Cancellazione reale: disabilitata (solo simulazione)'. Lookup mario → 'ma***@studio.it · accesso email · creato 2026-07-29 · abbonamenti attivi: 0' + counts (analyses:2, reminders:2, payment_transactions:1, referrals:1). Request form: mismatched emails → correct 400 error; attest unchecked → correct 400 error; valid submission → request listed as 'ma***@studio.it · verified · email_from_account_address'. Open request → fill ELIMINA + email → privacy-exec-real DISABLED (confirmed via element.disabled); privacy-exec-dryrun returns {dry_run:true, executed:false, plan:{delete:{analyses:2,reminders:2,email_verifications:0,referrals:1}, keep_for_fiscal_obligations:{payment_transactions:1,…}, anonymize_user_fields:[…], active_subscriptions:0}}. Retention sim (24/24) returns analyses_older:0/47, inactive_accounts:0/19. GET /api/admin/privacy/log contains actions: lookup, request_created, dry_run, retention_simulation (+ execute_blocked from previous iterations). Final verification: POST /api/auth/login mario@studio.it/secret123 → 200 (test account intact; NO real deletion happened).
critical_code_review_comments: signupTracking.js silently swallows ALL errors in reportAssistantSignup (correctly, to never block login) but it also hides diagnostic info; consider logging via console.warn when response is non-2xx so dev tools surface counting failures without affecting UX.

privacy_admin/router.py: _audit stores params/plan directly in the audit log — plans include counts but not emails/user_ids (good). However the audit log is read without pagination (sort+limit 200) and does not expose a server-side cursor; for larger operation volumes consider adding pagination parameters.

The assistant_events collection now holds signup_completed with utm_source but no TTL index was added (same comment as iteration 21). For GDPR-minimised tracking, add a TTL on created_at (e.g. 180 days).

AdminPrivacy.jsx: masked email duplicates in list — purely cosmetic. Also the Requests list could show the identity_method name translated instead of the raw key (currently shows 'email_from_account_address').
The /api/assistant/signup endpoint uses dedupe based on user_id only — if a user_id is somehow reused after anonymization it could collide; for current flow it is fine but worth documenting.

success_rate.backend: 100% (signup/existing_account + all curl assertions by main agent)
success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (assistant signup attribution, no-assistant register, existing-login after visit, admin/assistant KPI+table, admin/privacy end-to-end)

seed_data_creation: Created 2 throwaway test accounts via register: test_a<ts>@example.com (via assistant CTA, 3 credits, signup_completed with utm_source=linkedin logged) and test_b<ts>@example.com (direct register, NOT counted). 1 new privacy_requests record created for mario@studio.it (dry-run only, no deletion, request remains in 'verified' state).
context_for_next_testing_agent: ADMIN_DELETION_ENABLED=false in backend/.env — real deletion remains blocked (both server-side 403 and UI disabled button). Signup tracking end-to-end works: markFromAssistant in AssistantPage.go sets localStorage da_from_assistant on CTA click; reportAssistantSignup in App.js login() posts to /api/assistant/signup after both register and login. Backend window is 48h (SIGNUP_WINDOW_HOURS). mario@studio.it is a stable OLD account (July 2026) and safe to reuse to verify 'existing_account'. Current signup_completed total=2 (1 qr from previous iteration + 1 linkedin from this run); utm sources direct/qr/linkedin/site visible in /admin/assistant 'Per canale' table.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. All backend and frontend contracts from the review request behave as specified; no real deletion of any account/document/history occurred.
